brief: @buildthis.bisks.net Pigger (like Frogger), you are a big burly hairy pigman doctor of mathematics in Bridgeport, trying to cross Nash Lane to buy a 40 of the cheapest bourbon and must avoid rowdy students in their cars. Extra groovy shaders and vertigo effects on your way back across from the 7/11.
note: Pigger: a Frogger for Nash Lane — a burly pigman doctor of mathematics dodges traffic for the cheapest bourbon 40, then a real WebGL shader warps the walk home.
